onboarding.intro: FileGrove starts in Manual mode. You stay in control and choose when a folder is ready for Automatic organization.

automatic.body: Automatic keeps watching for new files. You can pause it at any time.
automatic.title: Turn on Automatic when ready

folder.body: FileGrove works only inside folders you select. Recommended categories create their own destinations there.
folder.title: Choose one folder

preview.body: Use Preview to see clear groups of files and their destinations before organizing.
preview.title: Preview before changing anything

onboarding.title: Your files, always under your control
onboarding.undoNote: Safe by default: moves are recorded, name conflicts keep files protected, and Undo can restore earlier batches one at a time.

action.deleteConfirm: I understand these files will be permanently deleted
action.deleteWarning: Matching files will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
action.label: Then
action.rerunAlwaysHint: This command will run for every matching file on every activation.
action.rerunOnceHint: By default the command runs once per unchanged file and command.

securityWarning.accept: I trust this command and accept the risk
securityWarning.body: The command runs with your Linux user permissions for each matching file. Only use commands you trust.
securityWarning.title: Run an external command automatically?

action.testButton: Choose a file and test command
action.testHint: Testing really executes the command once against a file you choose. It does not mark the file as processed.
action.trashHint: Files go to the Linux desktop trash and can be restored manually.

rules.createFirst: Click "New rule" to create your first custom rule.
rules.destinationManagedHint: Enter a name such as Images and FileGrove will create that folder inside every organized folder. Select destination to use another location.
rules.enableDangerousConfirm: Enable the potentially destructive rule “{{name}}”? It is assigned to {{count}} active automatic folder(s) and can run immediately: {{folders}}

label.allOfThese: When ALL of these conditions are met:
label.questionHeader: Which files should this rule apply to?

rules.safeDefault: Safe default: FileGrove moves files into a folder it creates automatically inside each organized folder.

rules.templatesDesc: Add a ready-to-use task. FileGrove creates its destination folder automatically.
rules.title: Rules

tokens.exifNote: EXIF values fall back safely when metadata is missing; camera-specific values may be empty.
tokens.help: Click a token to append it to the destination. Date tokens use file dates; EXIF tokens use photo metadata.

validation.invalidCondition: Complete every condition with a valid value.
validation.name: Enter a rule name.
validation.timeout: Timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds.
